records.agenda_item: Application for late registration by an M.Tech. student
records.discussion: The committee considered an application submitted via form MP-02 by a full-time M.Tech. student requesting permission for late registration due to unforeseen family medical emergencies past the notified deadline.
records.resolution: Resolved to recommend the late registration request to the Dean (Academic) / Chairperson, Senate for special consideration as no registration is normally allowed after the notified last date.

records.agenda_item: Sanction of Semester Leave for an M.Tech. student
records.discussion: The committee reviewed an application for semester leave for one semester by an M.Tech. student citing prolonged medical treatment supported by hospital documents. The provisions for semester leave up to a maximum of two semesters were verified.
records.resolution: Resolved that the request for semester leave is recommended for approval to the Dean (Academic), subject to valid reasons within the permissible limit of two semesters.

records.agenda_item: Review of Academic Deficiency and Grade Reports
records.discussion: The committee reviewed grade reports issued at the end of the previous semester and discussed cases where grade reports were required to be withheld due to pending fee dues or indiscipline cases.
records.resolution: Resolved that grade reports for students with uncleared Institute dues be withheld in accordance with ordinance guidelines.

records.agenda_item: Review of attendance shortages and examination eligibility
records.discussion: The committee examined course-wise attendance data and noted that students with less than 75% attendance in a subject are barred from appearing in the End Semester Examination, keeping relative grading criteria in perspective.
records.resolution: Resolved that warning notices be issued to students whose attendance is falling close to the threshold, and ineligible cases be barred from the end-semester examinations as per clause 7.1.
